transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'd like to get our launch-readiness discussion started. We have the new team-provisioning workflow passing functional, accessibility, and staging integration tests, and there are 200 eligible accounts in the production base. The draft plan proposes enabling it for 10% of those accounts across standard production regions next Tuesday. Before I make any decision on the production feature-flag configuration, we need to complete the standard launch-readiness meeting, which includes a customer-success review and a platform-capacity review. Can we get those reviews scheduled?

transcript.text: I need to flag something for the customer-success review. I confirmed with legal this morning that Northstar and Pine are covered by a pilot addendum requiring seven calendar days of customer notice before either account is enabled, and neither account has opted in. I haven't updated the launch ticket yet because legal confirmed the wording during a separate renewal review, but we need to make sure neither of those accounts is included in the 10% rollout next Tuesday unless we've given the required notice.

I haven't filed the capacity note yet, but this directly affects whether we can proceed with the rollout as drafted.

Theo, the pilot addendum notice requirement for Northstar and Pine means we must exclude them from next Tuesday's rollout unless notice was given seven days prior — and it hasn't been. Rina, the us-east queue limit of 12 activations means the draft's 10% plan (20 accounts across multiple regions) would exceed safe capacity in that region. Given these constraints, I'm inclined to proceed with a reduced rollout next Tuesday — capped at 12 accounts total, excluding Northstar and Pine, and limited to us-east only to stay within the measured safe capacity. But before I finalize anything, we still need to formally complete the customer-success review and platform-capacity review as part of our standard launch-readiness process. I'd also like Theo to update the launch ticket with the pilot addendum constraint and Rina to file the capacity note so everything is documented.
